one_liner: SendGrid has a broad REST v3 API with API-key Bearer auth, but new accounts only get a 60-day, 100/day trial before a paid plan is needed; only community MCP servers exist.
auth_notes: Bearer API key created in the SendGrid console. Basic auth with username/password is no longer accepted. No OAuth for third-party developers appears in the evidence.
access_notes: No free plan. New accounts get a 60-day trial (100 emails/day, no credit card), after which a paid plan is needed. Essentials starts around $19.95/month.
blocker_notes: The API works during the 60-day trial, but continued use needs a paid plan. Each user must also create and paste their own API key, since there is no OAuth.

evidence.quote: To use an API key, include an `Authorization` header with the value `Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>` in your request.
Basic Authentication is no longer accepted; you must use an API key.
